# SpriteAnimation

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Animation` · class

```csharp
public sealed class SpriteAnimation
```

A frame-by-frame sprite animation: a sequence of texture regions and their timing.

## Remarks

An animation is immutable and holds no playback state, so any number of [`SpriteAnimationPlayer`](SpriteAnimationPlayer.md)s can share one. Its regions belong to whatever owns their texture (typically a [`TextureAtlas`](TextureAtlas.md)), so disposing that invalidates the animation.

Every frame has the same logical size ([`TextureRegion.Size`](TextureRegion.md#size)): one canvas, redrawn. Trimmed atlas regions keep their logical size, so frames trimmed differently still share an origin.

## Constructors

```csharp
public SpriteAnimation(IReadOnlyList<TextureRegion> frames, float framesPerSecond, PlaybackMode playback = PlaybackMode.Loop)
```

Types: [`TextureRegion`](TextureRegion.md), [`PlaybackMode`](PlaybackMode.md)

Creates an animation whose frames each show for one frame at `framesPerSecond`.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `frames` | The frames, in order. Must not be empty, and every region must have the same size. |
| `framesPerSecond` | The frame rate. Must be positive and finite. |
| `playback` | How the animation plays through its frames. |

### GetFrameDuration

```csharp
public TimeSpan GetFrameDuration(int index)
```

Gets how long a frame shows: its [`SpriteAnimationFrame.Hold`](SpriteAnimationFrame.md#hold) divided by [`FramesPerSecond`](#framespersecond).

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `index` | The frame's index in [`Frames`](#frames). |

### GetFrameIndex

```csharp
public int GetFrameIndex(TimeSpan time)
```

Gets the index of the frame that shows at a time since the animation started. Has no state, so things that animate in lockstep can share one clock instead of each having a player.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `time` | The time since the animation started. Negative times show the first frame; times past the end of a [`PlaybackMode.Once`](PlaybackMode.md#once) animation show its last frame. |
